theme: CS5-4 container element used as a scalar is E0102
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): on a tuple pattern whose subject resolves only at solve time, a component whose element is a container (tuple, [T], Option, Result) used as a scalar, or a scalar element used as a container, is E0102 (use of pattern binding). New refusals: c3 (str_len of a tuple component, was a run panic) and c3p (println of a tuple component, its concrete twin already E0102). A use that leaves the binding unresolved stays unchecked.
